about: Which machine implements which prU ticket. Lanes are content skills (C-<lane>-NN, -refs, -example); explicit ticket ids win over lanes. Only content tickets of web-application, python-testing and python-architecture depend on another lane, so they stay on one machine. Edit this file (and commit it) to move work between machines; never run a ticket on both.

A.about: the first machine (M1, 8 GB): the tickets it had started, docs, F-01, and the web-application, python-testing and python-architecture content (the lanes that depend on each other)

B.about: the second, larger machine: the critical engine chain L0-07, L0-11..L0-17, L0-24, the independent content lanes, and python-coding plus python-tooling (moved from A on 2026-10-22 to balance the remaining work)
